18b · The heatmap (first slice)

docs/plans/heatmap.md — grid shell, volume-bucketed, a fixed 53-week trailing window (not data extent — a fresh account still renders a full, honest year of quiet cells). --hm1–--hm4 is a NEW ramp (not elevation), neutral by design; --signal appears exactly once, on today, regardless of that day’s own value. Rest/no-data is drawn (hairline outline, no fill), never dimmed. .hmCell (24-42px, the visual, responsive to the real container width) and .hmHit (a fixed 44px real tap target, centred on the cell, independent of its size) are deliberately two elements — the container itself (not the cell) widens on narrow screens to keep pitch ≥ hit-box size. Missed (a planned weekday, lib/train/routine.ts’s RoutineAssignment, with nothing logged) is a shape difference on an otherwise-unchanged rest cell, never a recolouring — a diagonal --fail line, not a fill. Record (--gold dot, top-right) is driven from classifyPR, the same function the live session’s PR badge already uses. Tapping a cell opens the day breakdown (openSessionAt, reusing the existing popup system): a session shows its volume, each lift’s sets/reps/weight and any record; a missed day names the routine that was scheduled; an ordinary rest day opens nothing — silence is a state. The tapped cell gets a neutral .hmCell.selected ring (--hair-strong), never --signal — today already owns that ring, and .hmCell.today.selected keeps it rather than contesting it. The legend’s swatches reuse .hmCell’s own rules rather than restating any colour.
